declared_object_scope: The complete Iranian Persian edition of The Open Logic Text as maintained by the Open Logic Project; this exact release is a source-ordered 10/722 checkpoint.
license: CC BY 4.0 unless a component is separately noted
coverage_and_topology: The snapshot contains the project introduction and opening structure plus the Sets chapter's six scheduled content units. It does not contain untranslated English fallback units.
component_source_hash_policy: Each included source unit records both the canonical LF Git-blob SHA-256 at the pinned commit and the CRLF checkout-materialization SHA-256 used by the accepted closure manifest.
authority_hierarchy: Accepted Persian target SHA-256 in evidence/COMPONENT_COVERAGE.tsv
source_worktree_caveat: The local read-only cache had an unrelated working LICENSE.md edit at release time. Packaging authority is the exact LF Git blob bytes, not the working copy; the separately recorded CRLF materialization hash identifies checkout conversion of the committed text.
excluded_scope: OLP-0011 through OLP-0722 are outside this exact checkpoint.
